first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The area of light blue sky visible beyond the hedge and the signboard roof.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: At the beginning, the person with a small amount of red-and-white clothing visible between the hedge archway and the signboard's left post.

entities.name: shaped hedge maze entrance
entities.identification: The tall green hedge wall in the background, with an entrance shaped with a pointed cone, lateral protrusions, and an archway.

entities.name: dark wooden pavilion
entities.identification: The small wooden pavilion on the image-left side, with a reddish-brown sloping roof, dark wooden-plank walls, and rectangular windowpanes in the upper portion.

entities.name: gray streetlamp in front of the hedge
entities.identification: The slender gray pole streetlamp to the right of the wooden pavilion, with a dark-framed lampshade and a short horizontal bar in its upper portion.

entities.name: large wooden-framed maze map signboard
entities.identification: The close-view dark brown wooden-framed signboard, with thick posts and a wide roof, a green maze map on a yellowish-brown background in the center, and light-colored sheets arranged beside it.

entities.name: branches and leaves behind the signboard
entities.identification: The dense dark green branches and leaves visible from beneath the signboard and along the image-right edge.

entities.name: grass in front of the hedge
entities.identification: The short green grass in the lower part of the image, on the near side of the gravel passage.

entities.name: gravel passage in front of the hedge
entities.identification: The light gray granular road surface in front of the wooden pavilion and hedge, including the visible sections leading toward the archway and behind the signboard.
